sources.name: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
facts: Release uses January 2026 OMR and an AddressBase Premium premises epoch filtered to postal, non-demolished premises
Files are split into 318 English and Welsh local-authority-district CSVs and include a maximum-1000-row sample
current_gigabit and future_gigabit are BDUK views derived from OMR and delivery data, not live retail-order confirmations
sources.access_guard: Use UPRN, source epoch and BDUK field definitions together; preserve struprn to avoid numeric corruption.
sources.limitation: A missing UPRN can reflect demolition, dereliction, a new build outside the AddressBase epoch or another scope exclusion; it cannot be converted automatically to no broadband.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK publication under Open Government Licence

sources.name: Connected Nations Planned Network Deployments 2026
facts: Report concerns operator plans through the end of 2028 rather than current availability
High Confidence plans require at least Low Level Design Complete and committed funding
BDUK OMR and Ofcom PND premises bases, respondents, evaluation methods and reference dates are not equivalent
sources.access_guard: Never merge planned deployment flags into current serviceability; retain plan confidence and reference date.
sources.limitation: A high-confidence network plan is not evidence that a specific parcel is currently passed, connected or orderable.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom report and methodology; Ofcom terms apply

sources.name: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans publication and sample
facts: Official publication exposes an OMR and BDUK plans sample CSV
The sample is approximately 174 KB and the complete release is distributed by local authority district
The publication applies to England and Wales and links to the technical user guide
sources.access_guard: The sample can validate field names and parsing only; it cannot establish national row completeness or current serviceability.
sources.limitation: A sample of at most 1000 rows is not a national inventory and cannot be extrapolated into missing parcel records.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK publication; Open Government Licence unless stated otherwise

sources.name: National Rolling Open Market Review September 2025 Request for Information
facts: Supplier coverage claims are analysed at UPRN level
White, Grey, Black and Under Review combine current infrastructure and three-year plans
Under Review explicitly includes unverified current claims or planned build with residual delivery risk or evidence gaps
sources.access_guard: Store subsidy-control status separately from current_gigabit and provider orderability.
sources.limitation: White/Grey/Black/Under Review are intervention classifications, not retail availability tests for a parcel.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK consultation material under Open Government Licence

sources.name: AddressBase LogicalStatusCode
facts: Logical status values include Approved, Alternative, Provisional and Historical
BLPU records do not use Alternative status while LPI records can use all listed values
Lifecycle status is attached to address records and must be preserved during joins
sources.access_guard: Only approved/current address records can enter an automatic production-binding candidate set; provisional or historical records require explicit handling.
sources.limitation: A live UPRN address record still does not prove title-polygon equivalence or broadband serviceability.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium BLPU representative point and lifecycle fields
facts: BLPU contains UPRN, logical status, coordinates and Representative Point Code
RPC describes the positional accuracy allocated to the BLPU coordinate by the local-authority custodian
BLPU also carries start date, local custodian and change metadata
sources.access_guard: Record RPC, logical status and source date before any point-in-polygon candidate binding; do not treat all points as equal-quality centroids.
sources.limitation: A representative point can fall within a building or land object without proving a legal title relationship or network connection.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS technical documentation; AddressBase Premium access terms apply

sources.name: Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset technical specification
facts: Dataset links HMLR title numbers to AddressBase UPRNs where an address relationship can be made
Fields are Title_No and UPRN
Published files show the last change made during the update period and are refreshed monthly
sources.access_guard: The authoritative direct relationship is chargeable, account-gated and licensed; it was documented but not acquired or substituted.
sources.limitation: Not every registered title can be linked to a UPRN, and access restrictions prevent using this dataset as the current free production path.
sources.access_and_licence: Chargeable National Polygon Service dataset requiring account, licence and payment

sources.name: National Polygon dataset technical specification
facts: National Polygon records include shape, Poly_ID, Title_No, insert/update dates, version and record status
Record status distinguishes added, changed and deleted polygons
Index polygons are indicative title-location indexes mapped against OS large-scale data
sources.access_guard: Polygon version and record status must be checked; deleted or superseded geometry cannot bind a current UPRN.
sources.limitation: The dataset is chargeable and index polygons show indicative rather than guaranteed exact legal boundaries.
sources.access_and_licence: Chargeable licensed HMLR National Polygon Service dataset

sources.name: National Polygon Service access, scope and validation overview
facts: Service comprises National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN Look Up datasets
National Polygon contains more than 25 million titles and 28 million polygons
Full data costs £20,000 per year plus VAT and requires an account and licence
sources.access_guard: Paid/account-gated sources are skipped under the project source policy; the free Bristol sample is not a national substitute.
sources.limitation: The service confirms an authoritative paid route exists but does not provide a free national parcel-to-UPRN inventory for migration.
sources.access_and_licence: Chargeable licensed service; free sample is account- and licence-gated
